figurative_meaning_en: to look at, to notice or pay attention
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে রাস্তার দিকে নজর করছিল না।
বাচ্চাটি খেলার সময় নজর করতে বললাম।
example_sentences_in_english: He wasn't looking at the road.
I told the child to pay attention while playing.
note: This idiom is derived from Persian 'nazar' meaning gaze, commonly used in Bengali for casual observation.
